verdict.rationale: Audit logging is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an audit or event log recording who changed which flag, when, and to what value. Change requests, RBAC and the Admin API are adjacent governance features and do not show that changes are recorded.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every flag change is recorded in an audit log — who changed what, when, and to which value
